name: XCcCashOp
caption: Əlavə modullar / Tikinti və kommunal / Kassa əməliyyatları

datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id, 'ozzun' ddd, p.paydate, p.id#, p.payamt,d.name
  FROM cc_payments  p, CC_DESCRIPTION d

where id#=:CrdID and p.descode=d.code
order by p.paydate desc
--order by :Title

datasets.name: cc_buyer_flats
datasets.sql:
select a.comp_name ||' '|| a.bld_name ||' mənzil '||a.flatnumber as address,a.bld_name,p.id,a.flatcode
from cc_buyer_flats a , cc_contracts c, cc_payments p
where a.buyer=c.buyer and c.id=p."ID#" and p.id=:PayID

datasets.name: ReportPayOrderData
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.paydate, 
       p.payamt,a.CONTAMOUNT,
       CC_GENERAL.get_contractaccount(a.accid) as LoanAccno,  
       CC_GENERAL.get_contractaccount(a.buyer) as ClientAccno,
       b.firstname||' '||b.lastname||' '||middlename as name,
       a.opendate,
       a.contnum as ccontractno,
       av.val_name,a.DUEINTERESTRATE,
 TRUNC (MONTHS_BETWEEN (A.OPENDATE,A.EXPDATE)) as period
  FROM cc_payments p,
       cc_contracts a,
       cc_buyers b,
       avalute av
where a.id =p.id#
and   a.buyer = b.id
and   av.valute = a.contcur
and   p.id = :PayID

datasets.name: AboutBank
datasets.sql:
select
  bank as FullBankName,
  Logo ,
  INN,
  MANAGERTITLE
from BANKINFO

datasets.name: Cash
datasets.sql:
select id, acc_no,name from
account where (bal_cn1 in (SELECT cashbalancenational
  FROM cash_settings))
or( bal_cn1 in (SELECT cashbalanceenglish
  FROM cash_settings)
)

and close_dat is null

datasets.name: Transactions
datasets.sql:
select
    DEBITACCNO,
    DEBITCURRENCY,
    CREDITACCNO,
    CREDITCURRENCY,
    TRDATE,
   INBALANCECHAR,
    FLAGS,
    DEBITAMOUNT,
    CREDITAMOUNT,
    NATAMOUNT,
    TRDESCRIPTION,
    CANPROCESS
  from SBCM_DELAYED_TRANSACTIONS

datasets.name: cc_contracts
datasets.sql:
select rownum,cont.code,cont.id as id,cont.contnum,cont.FIRSTNAME,cont.lastname,cont.MIDDLENAME,cont.acc_no,
       av.val_name,cont.contamount as creditamount, cont.bld_name, cont.FLATNUMBER,cont.rest, cont.comp_name,
       cont.entrance, cont.ffloor, cont.area  from  cc_activecontracts cont , avalute av
where av.valute = cont.contcur

datasets.name: main
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.monthpay ,i.suminterest,nvl(cc_general.gecikme(p.id),0) gecmeb,cc_general.gecgun(p.id)gun from cc_contracts p,cc_int_currstate i
 
 where p.id=i.countid
and  p.id=:cid
